purpose: Positive fixture of a Session that the v0.14.5 CLI wrote with a depth axis and a GC content axis in Percent mode, both with numbered ticks: its request's full config has no objects.depth.axis_labels or objects.gc_content.axis_labels (the label style did not exist), and the axes drew 0x 20x 40x 60x and 20% .. 70%. A reader keeps the numbered ticks for such a config (D-16, 2026-11-08).
route: in a directory holding a copy of tests/fixtures/regex_rules.gb as record.gb and depth.tsv (REGEX, positions 1..2051 every 50, depths 20..50): gbdraw circular --gbk record.gb --depth_track depth.tsv --depth_window 1 --depth_step 50 --depth_min 0 --depth_max 60 --show_depth_axis --show_depth_ticks --depth_large_tick_interval 20 --gc_content_mode percent --gc_content_min_percent 20 --gc_content_max_percent 70 --show_gc_content_axis --show_gc_content_ticks --gc_content_large_tick_interval 10 --window 100 --step 50 -o v0145-axes -f svg --session_output v0145-axes.gbdraw-session.json, with gbdraw from that tag; the written file was compressed with gzip -n -9
values: renderRequest.diagramOptions.config.objects.depth and .gc_content: no axis_labels; the Result draws the tick labels 0x 20x 40x 60x and 20% 30% 40% 50% 60% 70%
